source_identity.title: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile

scope: Every AI-specific R recommendation and C consideration in Table 1, printed pages 8–19: 75 canonical records. Sections 1–3 govern interpretation and scope.
excluded_material: Unmodified SSDF 1.1 baseline practices/tasks and no-additions rows as new 800-218A controls.
Informative references as primary authority for independent duties.
AI system deployment/operation and broader data management.
source_comparison_method: Reconstructed Table 1 AI-specific column from the official PDF text. Task and R/C locators align uniquely with every canonical record. All 75 summaries match corresponding primary bullet wording after punctuation/layout normalization. Posture, actor and development applicability were separately checked; this lexical test alone is not an occurrence compliance determination.
